source_quote: "Exploring a large codebase fills your context with file reads. Delegate the exploration so only the findings come back." (Claude Code docs, common workflows). Counter, same docs (best practices, 'What you can stop doing'): "Handing the same task to a subagent doesn't make the answer any better."
source_note: Approved by Sebi 20 Nov 2026 (PROTOCOL.md, Module 7 entry). Module 7 rules = private/m5/RULES.md 'Runs' plus private/m7/DESIGN.md 'Decisions (Sebi, 20 Nov 2026)': t2 + h2 at 9 runs each = 18 a side (`runs` is per task per side in run.py), Haiku 4.5 on every side, Claude Code 2.1.309 pinned by LAB_CLAUDE_BIN=~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.309, config dir ~/.claude-lab (claude.ai skill and plugin sync off), CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 on every side, standard verdict rule, three numbers before each run (pass rate, the behaviour count below, cost per passed run), the habit measured first, an agent reads every transcript, private/m7/tools/preflight.py run on the smoke and day events. allowed_tools_extra: earlier t2/h2 days added nothing because the runner's base list already covers the tasks' real commands (pnpm --filter <pkg> build/test, npx vitest, npx tsc, node); extras below exist only where the trick needs them. Design, kill switches and pilots: private/m7/DESIGN.md, RISKS.md.
behaviour_count: Runs with at least one Agent call with subagent_type Explore; main-thread input tokens (events with parent_tool_use_id null); the model Explore ran on (modelUsage)
habit_measure: Historical: 21 of 417 plain t1-t3 runs spawned a subagent unprompted (the with side is prompted, the without side has no Agent tool)
kill_switches: With side calls Explore in fewer than 12 of 18 runs: instruction didn't hold, no verdict
Without side's init tools still list Task or Agent: removal failed, stop
Explore runs on a non-Haiku model: not a kill; the post says 'Haiku plus an X researcher' and cost per pass carries it

with.label: Prefix: Explore subagent researches first, main agent edits
with.prompt_prefix: Start by using the Explore subagent to find the files and functions this task involves and report them back. Then make the change yourself based on its report.
